data.name: EmpireX - Business, Real Estate and Crime Simulator
data.detailed_description:
EmpireX is a deep and immersive mix of clicker game with crime and business empire simulator where you start as a low-level street dealer and build your own criminal organization from scratch. Manage drug production, street sales, political connections, money laundering, real estate investments, and even relationships — all in a living city full of opportunity and danger.

Every decision matters. Climb your way to the top, or be crushed by the streets you're trying to rule.

🧍 Create Your Character and Your Criminal Organization

Customize your appearance and define your gang's identity and style. Choose whether to build a ruthless, violent crew or a silent and calculated operation. Your reputation shapes your path through the criminal underworld.

💊 Buy, Sell, and Take Over the Streets

Buy from local suppliers and sell directly to final customers on the streets. Build loyalty, increase profits, and take control of neighborhoods one by one. Compete with rival dealers and avoid drawing too much police attention.

🚗 Explore the City and Gear Up

Purchase vehicles, weapons, and equipment to support your operations. Travel across the city, collect intel, run jobs, or simply show off your success. The streets are yours to conquer.

🏠 Real Estate & Front Businesses

Expand your empire through smart property investments and strategic business ownership. Buy undervalued homes, renovate and flip or rent them for steady income — or turn them into stash houses for your operations. Open restaurants, gyms, or shops to generate legit revenue or use them as dirty fronts to launder money. Whether for profit or cover, buildings are more than bricks — they’re power.

🧪 Produce and Distribute

Set up drug labs with basic tools or sophisticated equipment. Optimize your production, manage raw materials, and ensure your product reaches dealers or distributors on time and intact.

📊 Manage Your Criminal Network

Handle your frequent customers and dealers carefully. Don’t be late, or you’ll risk losing trust and reputation. A stable and loyal network is essential for long-term success.

📈 Game Future

  • More stores, clothes, guns, furniture's... 

  • Weapon and ammo production and distribution

  • Expansion to new states and countries

  • Global drug and weapons trade operations

  • Clothing, jewelry, and full appearance customization

  • Love and double life, partner, date, even get married — all while hiding your criminal empire.

🗓️ Launch planning

We are working hard and currently finishing some major mechanics and soon its ready we will launch the Alpha. The is that alpha will be release till end of August.



Access our discord for more information and devlog!

EmpireX is a work of fiction with mature themes, adult language, and depictions of illegal activity. It does not promote or encourage real-world criminal behavior.

content_descriptors.notes:
EmpireX is a simulation game intended for mature audiences. It revolves around building a criminal empire and contains sensitive content that may not be suitable for all players. The game includes the following elements:

Crime-related themes: Players manage a criminal organization involved in drug trafficking, money laundering, corruption, and theft.

Drug and alcohol use: The game features representations of drug production, sale, and consumption as part of its gameplay.

Implied violence: While the game includes heists, confrontations, and risky situations, these are presented through text and static or symbolic images — with no graphic depictions of violence or gore.

Mild sexual and suggestive content: Some storylines involve romantic relationships and double lives, but there is no nudity or depiction of sexual acts.

Strong language: Dialogues and descriptions may include mature or offensive language.

This game does not promote or condone real-life illegal or immoral behavior and is a fictional interactive experience with mature themes.
